notes: Wall time with profiling overhead; not normal game latency. Current thread only. Includes Python, standard library and reported native calls, tournament setup and summary writing; imports/deck loading before run_tournament and profiler export are excluded. Calls for generators/coroutines count active segments (each resume), not logical generator instances; their maxima/averages also describe segments and exclude suspended time. Inclusive totals include nested calls and recursive activations, so do not sum them. Self times subtract recorded children but still contain profiler overhead. Native operations without profile events cannot be separated from their caller. Maximum is one observed call/segment, not a percentile or a repeatable worst case.
